changes.summary: Create a draft ChangeSet bound to an approved plan step; records scope only and creates no staging directory.
Materialize or rescan the staging tree, record preimages/postimages and publish a prepared revision with an S19 prepared_digest.
List latest ChangeSet revisions, optionally filtered by effective state.
Reviewable before/after previews read from CAS blobs; previews are explicitly truncated and never authoritative.
Append a prepared_change approval bound to the exact prepared_digest. Plan-scope approval alone never authorizes apply.
Acquire the project lease, recheck every preimage, write the durable journal, replace files one by one and capture the resulting snapshot. State becomes applied, not accepted.
Restore only this ChangeSet's journaled writes in reverse order; differing user content is preserved as a conflict and a CAS artifact.
Append a rejected revision from draft, approved or prepared.
Inspect the current writer lease owner, fencing token and expiry.
Report ChangeSets whose latest state or journal indicates an interrupted apply.

apply_requirements.lease: owner token + monotonically increasing fencing token

recovery_requirements.journal: durable apply_journal written before the first replacement
recovery_requirements.conflict_rule: restore only when current bytes equal the postimage; preserve differing content
